data.gender_notes: Gashmeer is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: One who has the strength of a mountain
data.long_meaning: Gashmeer is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Gashma' which means 'mountain'. This name signifies strength and the ability to overcome challenges, just like a mountain that stands firm against the test of time. It is also associated with wisdom and intelligence. The name Gashmeer carries the meaning “One who has the strength of a mountain” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Gashmeer usually hope their child will grow to embody one who has the strength of a mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Gashmeer is a powerful name that symbolizes strength, wisdom, and the ability to overcome obstacles in life. It is believed that individuals with this name possess a strong connection to the divine and are able to tap into the inner wisdom to navigate through life's challenges.
data.etymology: Gashmeer belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who has the strength of a mountain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gashmeer total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
